risks.statement: No production Android, Apple, Windows, Linux manifest, store, or publication credential has been enrolled and exercised for the current revision.
risks.required_action: Enroll each separated signing role at its explicit human boundary and retain exact artifact verification, recovery, install, update, and compromise-response evidence.

risks.statement: The named supported-system clean-install, authenticated-upgrade, failed-upgrade rollback, and old-version compatibility matrix is not complete.
risks.required_action: Run the final signed artifact set on every declared physical support cell and retain the complete transition record.

risks.statement: A second controlled build is a reproducibility measurement only; no externally administered reproduction has been supplied.
risks.required_action: Obtain a separately administered, revision-bound reproduction report covering every candidate artifact.

risks.statement: No qualified external security reviewer has completed the stable-v1 scope and retest disposition.
risks.required_action: Authorize reviewer contact separately, complete the accepted scope, retain findings and dispositions, and obtain retest evidence for corrections.

risks.statement: Simulator and host evidence do not close named physical mobile, real-network, accessibility, or two-radio qualification rows.
risks.required_action: Run the exact final artifacts on every named physical device, real network, accessibility environment, and stock-radio bench.

risks.statement: No public bootstrap, rendezvous, mailbox, wake, or Private-ingress deployment has revision-bound capacity, backup, upgrade, incident, replacement, and independent-operation evidence.
risks.required_action: Qualify the exact least-authority deployments and retain evidence from at least two genuinely independent operators before any plural claim.

risks.statement: The conformance kit has no separately produced implementation or external fixture producer result.
risks.required_action: Run the versioned kit through a separately produced path and retain the exact adapter, revision, fixture, and result record.

risks.statement: No consent-based Alpha pilot has run against production-like signed artifacts, and no privacy-preserving aggregate outcome exists.
risks.required_action: After entry conditions and separate authorization are met, run the bounded pilot and retain only the aggregate record defined by the stable-beta plan.

risks.statement: Qualified legal review, founder artwork provenance attestation, a backup security steward, and a live human incident/continuity exercise are absent.
risks.required_action: Complete the proportionate legal and provenance review, accept a backup steward, and retain a live incident and continuity disposition.

risks.statement: The final candidate P0 audit, support/update window, rollback decision, signed evidence archive, and founder go/no-go record do not exist.
risks.required_action: Complete the stable-beta readiness record for one immutable final candidate without treating it as merge, publication, tagging, or stable authorization.

claim: These risks block a stable claim and public stable release until revision-bound evidence closes them.
